# DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{org}/repos

Delete all repositories in an organization (async background deletion)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (reqToken + reqOrgOwnership + AccessTokenScopeCategoryRepository) · **ID:** `ep-036`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |

## Response

**202** — empty

- **204** — no repositories to delete
- **403** — not org owner
- **404** — organization not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | orgAssignment(true) + reqOrgOwnership() | utility | resolve org; verify ownership |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | org.DeleteOrgRepos | controller ⏳ | get all repo IDs for org; if empty return 204; spawn background goroutine; return 202 |
| 3 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | org.deleteOrgReposBackground | service ⏳ | for each repoID: GetRepositoryByID then DeleteRepository; log errors as system notices |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Org repo deletion requires org ownership (not just membership) | authorization | user must have AccessModeOwner in team_user join |
| Org repo deletion is async - returns 202 immediately, deletes in background | business_logic | len(repoIDs) > 0 |
| If org has no repos, return 204 No Content instead of 202 | business_logic | len(repoIDs) == 0 |
| Background repo deletion continues on individual failures, logs as system notice | business_logic | DeleteRepository returns error |

### Error Paths

- **org not found** → orgAssignment middleware → 404
- **not org owner** → reqOrgOwnership middleware → 403
- **GetOrgRepositoryIDs fails** → DeleteOrgRepos → 500
- **background deletion fails** → deleteOrgReposBackground → 0

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| medium | unbounded_queries | GetOrgRepositoryIDs loads ALL repo IDs without pagination | Acceptable since only IDs are loaded (not full objects), but could add a safety limit |
| medium | n_plus_1_queries | Background deletion loops through repos one-by-one: GetRepositoryByID then DeleteRepository | Acceptable for background processing; individual deletion ensures partial progress on failure |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P3] async**: Already uses async background deletion - good pattern — *Impact: Request returns immediately (202), deletion happens in background*

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** high

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ❌ missing | high | Background deletion of repos is not atomic - partial deletion leaves org in inconsistent state with some repos deleted and others remaining |
| idempotency | ❌ missing | medium | Calling DELETE /repos twice could trigger a second background deletion while first is still running |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ Sequential repo deletion in background - partial failure leaves some repos deleted, others intact

**Cascading failure risk:** Background goroutine uses graceful shutdown context; if server shuts down mid-deletion, remaining repos are not deleted

**Graceful degradation:** Errors logged as system notices; individual repo failures don't stop other deletions
